notes:
Status: Closed (lost) to hyperscaler managed endpoints.

Background: Obsidian is a mid-size observability platform building AI-driven alert triage and runbook automation. Engaged late 2025 for a Dedicated/private evaluation — wanted VPC deployment, strict data residency, KMS integration.

Why we lost:
- Security + Cloud Infra pushed for consolidation on native cloud AI offerings (AWS Bedrock) to keep traffic inside their existing networking + IAM flows.
- Procurement locked on a cost model tied to existing cloud credits and preferred vendor contracting — difficult to match on short timeline.
- Internal champion (VP of Platform) left in Jan; new hire deprioritized external inference platform.

Engagement timeline snippets / shorthand:
- 2025-11-04 discovery w/ Diego + Maya (ff_20251104) — clear VPC + residency requirement.
- 2025-12-15 security deep-dive; delivered security FAQ + SOC2 mappings (ff_20251215).
- 2026-01-10 POC started (4-week) — focus on embeddings + reranking for incident search.
- 2026-02-12 final demo with SysOps; SysOps asked for direct Bedrock integration patterns (ff_20260212_final-demo).
- 2026-02-19 AE follow-up; no reply. Procurement confirmed preference for Bedrock on 2026-02-24 (Gmail thread).

Quotes / call notes:
- "We want to keep inference traffic within our AWS accounts if possible." — Director, Cloud Ops
- "If it works better with Bedrock and is cheaper, we won't keep both vendors." — Procurement lead

POC notes / tech tradeoffs:
- POC latency and quality were acceptable; cost modeling favored Redwood for steady high-volume due to batching & kv-cache.
- Customer valued Redwood Optimize suggestions but procurement focused on vendor consolidation savings and single-bill.

Next steps (internal):
- Mark as closed-lost, reason: hyperscaler_managed_endpoints.
- Add to playbook for similar accounts: emphasize clear TCO comparison vs Bedrock, prepare quick AWS integration playbook, and capture willing-to-pay signals earlier.
- Re-attempt outreach in 6-9 months post re-org or if they signal multi-cloud needs.

Attachments / references: pricing deck, security FAQ, POC results located in Drive links above. Jira tickets referenced SUP-4821 (env setup), SUP-4973 (kv-cache tuning).
